title: Onsager--Machlup Functional for Fractional Stochastic Newton Dynamics with Time-Dependent Noise Intensities
summary: In this paper, we derive the Onsager--Machlup functional for a second-order Newton-type stochastic system driven by time-dependent fractional noise, \[ X_t'' = f_t(X_t, X_t') + σ_t \,ξ_t^{H}, \] where \( H \in (1/4,1) \). The analysis relies on applying a Girsanov transformation to the non-degenerate components and evaluating the limiting conditional expectation associated with the noise term, for which the stochastic Fubini theorem plays a crucial role. To illustrate the applicability of the result, we study two mechanical systems perturbed by noise and provide supporting numerical…
